inputs.description: Modpack version — dotted number, NO 'V' prefix (e.g. 1.1.8)
Baseline ref = commit of the LAST PUBLISHED pack version (NOT the last commit). e.g. V1.1.8 = 0b5da501. Derives <baseline>..HEAD.
Target mod name substring (from the pack) to de-risk on a fast minimal instance
CurseForge numeric project id for gigafauna (created by hand at console.curseforge.com)
CurseForge numeric project id for matoulib
CurseForge numeric project id for the Gigafauna modpack (slug gigafauna-pack)
Async chunk-gen pipeline flag state that is BOOTED (must match -Dmatoulib.chunk.pipeline)
Baseline artifact name (e.g. C0-OFF, C1-ON) — written to memory/bench-captures/
A/B reference artifact label (usually the OFF capture)
A/B candidate artifact label (the ON capture)
ArchaicFix Phosphor state that is BOOTED (must match ArchaicConfig.enablePhosphor) — light metric only

tasks.label: Devtools: build minimal de-risk instance (+boot/heal)
tasks.detail: Assemble a ~90s-boot minimal instance (coremod baseline + OaT + target mod + extras) to de-risk ONE mixin before the ~8min full pack. Auto-heals missing FML deps (boot-and-heal: detect 'requires mods [X]' -> resolve modid->jar -> reboot). RPC on 127.0.0.1:25580.

tasks.label: Pack: generate client+server zips
tasks.detail: Build dist/BiggessPackCatEdition<v>.zip (client) + ...ServerPack<v>.zip. Bumps manifest+modpack.json. Self-verifies.

tasks.label: Pack: bundle check (fetchability) — PREFLIGHT
tasks.detail: Every bundle mod downloadable? (CF Approved+downloadUrl, URL 200 via GET). Run before EVERY pack release. BUG-010.

tasks.label: Pack: bundle check (orphans / completeness)
tasks.command: python3 bundle_check.py --orphans "${env:HOME}/Documents/curseforge/minecraft/Instances/Biggess Pack Cat Edition V1 TEST/mods"
tasks.detail: Jars in the instance that NO bundle delivers (would be missing for players).

tasks.label: Tooling: packenv resolve check (paths/ids)
tasks.detail: Print every canonical path/id packenv resolves on THIS machine (✓/✗ = exists) + which secrets are set. Run after a machine move / renamed instance to confirm .env overrides land. Single source of truth for all pack tooling.

tasks.label: Tooling: Prism jar sync (dry-run) — SAFE
tasks.detail: Report which <mod>-test.jar in each PrismLauncher instance is STALE vs the freshest build/libs jar of its repo (matched by build-artifact prefix, so the RustMap→MatouMap rebrand is handled by the jar name). Read-only. Closes the proactive-deploy gap: a rebuilt jar not redeployed => the user relaunches Prism and tests a stale binary.

tasks.label: Tooling: Prism jar sync (--apply)
tasks.detail: Copy each fresh build/libs jar over its STALE <mod>-test.jar in the Prism instances (same filename). Mutates local test instances only (never outward). Run the dry-run first; takes effect on next instance launch.

tasks.label: Release: reserve slugs (dry-run + CF checklist) — SAFE
tasks.detail: docs/26 clean-room: verify the MODRINTH_TOKEN + report which of gigafauna/matoulib/gigafauna-pack slugs are already TAKEN vs free on Modrinth, and print the manual CurseForge creation checklist (name/slug/type/category/license/summary). Read-only, no project is created. CF has no create-project API, so those are created by hand at console.curseforge.com.

tasks.label: Release: reserve slugs on Modrinth (--execute) — OUTWARD
tasks.detail: OUTWARD: create the three Modrinth projects (gigafauna, matoulib, gigafauna-pack) as DRAFTS (slug claimed, not public). Idempotent — an already-taken slug is skipped. License MIT. Canonical copy lives in reserve_slugs.py PROJECTS. After this, create the CF projects by hand then run the wire task below.

tasks.label: Release: generate placeholder brand logos
tasks.detail: docs/26 clean-room: (re)generate the 512x512 placeholder PNG logos (gigafauna / matoulib / gigafauna-pack) into assets/brand/. Deterministic. Temporary art to satisfy CurseForge's mandatory avatar + Modrinth's icon; drop a real file with the same name to replace.

tasks.label: Release: dump listing text (CF copy-paste)
tasks.detail: docs/26 clean-room: write each project's title/summary/body markdown + CF fields to assets/listing/<slug>.txt so the description can be pasted into the CurseForge project form by hand. Offline, no token, creates nothing.

tasks.label: Release: refresh Modrinth icons (--icons) — OUTWARD
tasks.detail: OUTWARD: upload/replace the Modrinth icon of the EXISTING gigafauna/matoulib/gigafauna-pack projects from assets/brand/<slug>.png (PATCH /project/{id}/icon). Use after regenerating logos or dropping real art. No project is created.

tasks.label: Release: wire reserved ids into release-manifest
tasks.detail: After Modrinth drafts exist AND the CF projects were created by hand: record each Modrinth id + CF numeric project id into memory/release-manifest.json (never clobbers existing). Unblocks release_mods multi-platform publish + dist_parity parity checks.

tasks.label: Tooling: regenerate ARCHITECTURE.md (arch map)
tasks.detail: Statically AST-scan every *.py in this repo (no imports/execution) and regenerate ARCHITECTURE.md — a Mermaid diagram + overview table showing which script imports which, and which packenv data artifact (bundles, manifest, repos.json, instances, CF/Modrinth secrets) each one touches. Run after adding/removing a script or a packenv key; `python3 arch_map.py --check` (exit non-zero if stale) is the CI/preflight form.

tasks.label: Pack: bundle regression gate (no downgrade vs published cut)
tasks.detail: GATE 10: every mod in the mod-director bundles must be >= the newest version ever published (scan all 'release: cut' commits). Catches a reverse-sync/edit that silently downgraded a fileID/version (a2ee2f28). Pinned mods (FileDirector) exempt. Exit 2 on regression.

tasks.label: Pack: server bootstrap parity (check) — PREFLIGHT
tasks.detail: GATE 8: the server launcher (lwjgl3ify forgePatches jar + 3startserver.sh/.bat) matches the bundle version, AND no client-only (side=CLIENT) mod sits on the server. Untracked by mod-director/pack_sync. Exit 2 on drift.

tasks.label: Pack: server bootstrap parity (fix startscripts + drop stale jar)
tasks.detail: Rewrite the startscript version tokens to the bundle version (byte-preserving: .sh=LF/.bat=CRLF) + drop stale forgePatches jars. Add --forgepatches-src <jar> to install the new bootstrap jar when absent (a binary can't be fabricated).

tasks.label: Pack: sync bundle fileIDs vs GitHub (audit)
tasks.detail: Compare pack bundles vs real GitHub releases — catches stale forks outside the tracking. Preflight before a pack release.

tasks.label: Pack: sync bundle fileIDs (apply)
tasks.detail: Write synced fileIDs into curse.bundle + client_manifest + server_jar + url.bundle (byte-mode, preserves CRLF).

tasks.label: Pack: publish changelog (derive→preview)
tasks.detail: Derive (bundles+config since baseline) → preview the publish-ready block. For curated wording: derive to a file, edit it, then changelog_publish.py --from-derive <file>.

tasks.label: Pack: publish changelog (derive→PREPEND)
tasks.detail: Insert the derived block into the pack CHANGELOG for real (uncurated — prefer --from-derive with a curated file for player-facing wording).

tasks.label: Pack: smoke test (server)
tasks.detail: Boot a throwaway server clone, report PASS/FAIL. Never touches the real instance.

tasks.label: Pack: smoke test (server + client auto-join)
tasks.detail: Server stays up, client boots + joins; confirmed via server log. Needs DISPLAY.

tasks.label: Release: dry-run all mods
tasks.detail: Stage 1 verify (tree/branch/targets) + Stage 2 build/plan. Publishes nothing.

tasks.label: Release: EXECUTE all mods (publishes!)
tasks.detail: REAL: tag + build + GitHub + CurseForge + Modrinth. Outward/public.

tasks.label: Local: update instances (dry-run)
tasks.detail: Preview swapping built personal jars into main/TEST/server.

tasks.label: Local: update instances (apply)
tasks.detail: rm old + cp new jars into instances. Launch with -Dmoddirector.devMode=true after.

tasks.label: Housekeep: archive resolved bugs (dry-run)
tasks.detail: Preview moving resolved bugs from BUGS.md to BUGS-archive.md.

tasks.label: Verify tokens (CF + Modrinth)
tasks.detail: Check the upload tokens are valid before a release.

tasks.label: Config: diff canonical vs instances
tasks.detail: Preview game-config drift: canonical src/common/config vs TEST+server. A config CHANGE is edited in the CANONICAL (never the instance directly). Add --only <path> manually to scope.

tasks.label: Config: APPLY canonical -> instances
tasks.detail: Copy canonical config -> TEST+server (CRLF-safe). AFTER: changelog **config updated** + bump version + generate zips to ship client+server.

tasks.label: Security: GitHub alerts across mods
tasks.detail: Pull GitHub Dependabot + code-scanning alerts across owned mods (is_mod). Fix at the ecosystem level (cargo/gradle bump). Needs gh authed. Run before a release.

tasks.label: Changelog: derive from git (per mod)
tasks.detail: Each owned mod's commits since its last release tag = its pending changelog (the commit IS the source, so it can never be stale/missing). --markdown for release-notes format. Curate wording at release.

tasks.label: Pack: changelog derive (bundles+config)
tasks.detail: Derive the WHOLE pack changelog for <baseline>..HEAD from git: mod add/update/remove (mod-director bundles + CF manifest, version-aware) PLUS game-config changes (src/common/config, mod-director/ excluded — one line per changed file, dirs with many files summarized, comment/blank-only edits filtered as noise). Baseline = commit of the last PUBLISHED pack version, not the last commit. Curate wording at release. Add --config-only / --no-config to scope.

tasks.label: Profile: spark (in-game, save-to-file)
tasks.detail: Drive /spark profiler via matoulib RPC (game must be up, -Dmatoulib.rpc=true). Saves .sparkprofile locally — NEVER uploads (spark.lucko.me = public).

tasks.label: Devtools: matoulib conversion-opportunity census (rank mods)
tasks.detail: GET /census via matoulib RPC (game up, -Dmatoulib.rpc=true; works at the main menu, no world). Ranks pack mods by volume of content matoulib's data-driven systems could absorb (entities/fluids/blocks/items) + shows matoulib's own coverage vs the gap. Read-only. --json for raw, --top N to trim.

tasks.label: Pack: RELEASE dry-run (gates+plan)
tasks.detail: Gated pack release DRY-RUN (read-only): tree clean + pack_sync consistency (Approved-only) + fork audit + bundle_check (fetchable/Approved) + changelog preview. Baseline = commit of the LAST PUBLISHED version.

tasks.label: Pack: RELEASE EXECUTE (uploads to CF!)
tasks.detail: Same gates, then FOR REAL: build zips + upload client+serverpack to CF (outward-publish) + prepend changelog. Push stays manual.

tasks.label: Pipeline: status (repo→release→CF→pack→instances)
tasks.detail: End-to-end delivery dashboard: unreleased commits per mod, CF latest file status, pack bundle refs, stale instance jars + NEXT ACTIONS. Read-only. Run at session start and before any release.

tasks.label: Wiki: sync OaT Mixins page (generate from code)
tasks.command: rm -rf /tmp/oat-wiki && git clone -q https://github.com/quentin452/OptimizationsAndTweaks.wiki.git /tmp/oat-wiki && python3 wiki_sync.py --wiki /tmp/oat-wiki && git -C /tmp/oat-wiki diff --stat
tasks.detail: Regenerate wiki Mixins.md from asm/Mixin.java + mixin javadocs (kills the stale-wiki class). Review the diff, then commit+push the wiki clone yourself (PUBLIC).

tasks.label: Diag: OaT mixin collisions (pre-boot)
tasks.detail: Cross-mod contested-target report: where OaT @Overwrite/@Redirect fights another pack mod on the same class/method (CRITICAL/HIGH). Static, ~10s cold / 0.1s cached. Catches collisions BEFORE an 8min boot. Add --json, --no-cache, or --severity-min LOW.

tasks.label: Diag: dist parity (GH vs Modrinth/CF)
tasks.detail: Read-only cross-platform release-parity for personal mods: flags GAP (GitHub ahead of an existing Modrinth/CF project) + UNMANAGED + HUB_LIST_DRIFT. Universe = hub 1.7.10.MD + repos.json + manifest. Publishes nothing. Run after any mod GH release + at release-session start.

tasks.label: Release: mods dry-run (auto version+bump)
tasks.detail: Dry-run plan for the personal mods: auto-derives the next version from git tags AND the bump level from commit types (feat->minor, fix/perf->patch, feat!->major), prints the boot-verify plan. Read-only. Add --execute (uploads to GH/CF/Modrinth!) only after a full dry-run + user go.

tasks.label: Bench: chunk-gen baseline (capture)
tasks.detail: RIGOROUS chunk-gen baseline for the async-chunk rewrite (docs/32). Drives /worldgen/genprofile (ms/chunk median+p95 over N runs, drop warmup, deterministic virgin origins) + /metrics tick-health sampled under load + /worldgen/fingerprint bit-identity, writes a frozen artifact to memory/bench-captures/. IDLE-GUARD: refuses if ps --sort=-pcpu shows a competing hog or nvidia-smi shows GPU contention (the 'machine trop chargee fausse tout' lesson) — pass --force to override (recorded). Boot ONE matoulib-RPC instance in-world with the matching -Dmatoulib.chunk.pipeline flag FIRST (single-instance rule); the booted flag is verified against --flag.

tasks.label: Bench: chunk-gen A/B compare
tasks.detail: A/B two frozen chunk-gen artifacts: reports the ms/chunk delta WITH the run-to-run spread — a delta inside the combined noise band is called INCONCLUSIVE, not a win (kills the noisy single-shot A/B). Also checks the /worldgen/fingerprint hashes: a mismatch = the async path changed generated blocks = HARD gate FAIL (exit 3), independent of any speedup.

tasks.label: Bench: light capture
tasks.detail: C2 async-light A/B (hub docs/45), same rigor skeleton as the chunk-gen bench: drives /worldgen/lightperf (relight ADD/REMOVE us over N deterministic origins, drop warmup) + /metrics tick-health sampled under load + /worldgen/lightfingerprint sky/block-nibble bit-identity, writes a frozen artifact to memory/bench-captures/. IDLE-GUARD same as chunk. Cross-checks --flag against /metrics.asyncLight (the EFFECTIVE C2 state) AND --phosphor against the 'phosphor' field ArchaicFix stamps into lightperf — fails loudly on either mismatch. Boot ONE matoulib-RPC instance in-world with the matching -Dmatoulib.chunk.asyncLight (requires master -Dmatoulib.chunk.pipeline=true) and ArchaicConfig.enablePhosphor FIRST (single-instance rule).

tasks.label: Bench: light A/B compare
tasks.detail: A/B two frozen light-perf artifacts (must both be --metric light captures, else it refuses): reports the relight ADD-us and REMOVE-us deltas WITH the run-to-run spread — a delta inside the combined noise band is INCONCLUSIVE, not a win. Also checks the /worldgen/lightfingerprint sky+block hashes: a mismatch = the async-light path changed lit nibbles = HARD gate FAIL (exit 3), independent of any speedup. Same command as the chunk compare task — it auto-detects the metric from the artifact.
